nodes.label: Mirror Covers To Own Storage
nodes.rationale: Third-party CDN URLs rot; mirroring gives a stable URL under our control.

nodes.label: Steam Cover Art Resolution
nodes.rationale: library_600x900.jpg only exists for roughly 60-70% of titles; newer games moved CDN path and some never had portrait art.

nodes.label: IStoreBrowseService Is Not A Public API
nodes.norm_label: istorebrowseservice is not a public api
nodes.rationale: Returns 403 without a Steam session cookie, and its items key the appid as 'id' not 'appid'. Both failures were silent because non-200 responses were skipped.

nodes.label: Next.js Version Differs From Training Data
nodes.norm_label: next.js version differs from training data
nodes.rationale: APIs, conventions and file structure differ from memory; the bundled docs in node_modules/next/dist/docs are the source of truth.

nodes.label: Signed HMAC Session Token
nodes.rationale: The cookie must never contain AUTH_SECRET itself; a leaked cookie would then be the environment secret. Uses Web Crypto so the same code runs in Edge middleware and Node handlers.

nodes.label: create-next-app Boilerplate README
nodes.rationale: Untouched scaffold text; describes none of this project's actual behaviour.

nodes.label: Idempotent Manual Migrations
nodes.rationale: prisma db push cannot reach the Supabase instance, so every schema change is a hand-written script pasted into the SQL editor. Each is wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT with IF NOT EXISTS guards so a re-run is a no-op.

nodes.label: Assert The Database, Not The Screen
nodes.norm_label: assert the database, not the screen
nodes.rationale: A throwing server component renders the error boundary as HTTP 200, and browser checks passed while Postgres held four rows for three expenses. Verification reads the data store.

nodes.label: Session Continuity Via PROGRESS.md
nodes.rationale: The container is wiped between sessions with no warning, so state must live in git and be written as work happens. A SessionStart hook loads it automatically.

nodes.label: SSR Hydration Race on Image onError
nodes.norm_label: ssr hydration race on image onerror
nodes.rationale: Next.js server-renders the img tag; the browser fires the error event for a 404 cover before React hydrates and attaches onError, so the broken-image icon is already painted. Four fixes failed before this was understood.

nodes.label: Migration Run Order Depends On Direction
nodes.norm_label: migration run order depends on direction
nodes.rationale: A migration that ADDS must run before the code that uses it; one that REMOVES must run after the code stops referencing it, because Prisma names every column explicitly in its SELECTs. Getting this backwards broke books and manga in production.

nodes.label: Status Derived From Progress Counts
nodes.rationale: Watch and read status is computed from progress on every write rather than chosen by hand, so a status can never contradict its counts.

nodes.label: Universe / Series / Entry Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Every media section groups as Universe then Series then entry, with SetNull foreign keys so deleting a parent regroups its children rather than deleting them. Movies stop at two levels.

nodes.label: Idempotency Must Be Server-Side
nodes.rationale: A client-side lock cannot stop duplicate submissions across page contexts (two tabs, or a navigation racing the online event). Enforced with a unique clientId and an upsert.
